items.title: INFESTED CITIES
items.text:
INFESTED CITIES
Your character gets exposed if you begin your turn in an infested city.
(If it also contains a Plague cube, you get exposed only once, not twice.)

rules: Your character gets exposed if you begin your turn in an infested city.
If the city also contains a Plague cube, you get exposed only once, not twice.
mechanics.effect: Starting a turn in an infested city exposes the character once, even if a Plague cube is there too. The sticker has a rat in a green circle and no other text.

items.title: Area 14 placement
items.text: Put this sticker on the game board onto Area 14.

mechanics.effect: Place the Infested Cities sticker on Area 14 of the game board.

summary: Infested Cities rule sticker for Area 14. Beginning a turn in an infested city exposes you once; a Plague cube in the same city does not add a second exposure.
